desc:
🌸 Rip anime card packs, pull legendary traits and build the richest card empire in the Sakura shrine town! 🌸

🃏 OPEN PACKS: 150 cards across 30 packs, from Rookie to Genesis. Watch your rarest pulls burst onto the screen!
✨ CHASE TRAITS: Any pull can roll one of 12 traits, up to the ultra rare Celestial x50.
🏯 BUILD YOUR SHRINE: Show off your cards on glowing holo stands. Every card earns coins every second, even while you're offline!
⚔️ BOSS FIGHTS: A boss storms the town every 30 minutes. Battle it with your cards to win gems!
🔮 MERGE & REROLL: Fuse cards into better ones and reroll traits at the event park machines.
🎉 SERVER EVENTS: Surprise luck and coin boosts for everyone.
📜 DAILY QUESTS: Quests, daily streaks and free playtime gifts.
🤝 TRADE & GIFT: Trade with players, gift cards to friends and shop the market shared by every server.
👥 PLAY WITH FRIENDS: Earn a bonus with friends in your server.
🏆 Climb the global leaderboards!

👍 Use code WELCOME for free cash!
